title: Lazy Sunday Venezuelan Umeboshi Bowl
description: A pungent and springy vegan dish featuring umeboshi, perfect for a lazy Sunday, with a unique spherification twist, combining Venezuelan flavors with Japanese umeboshi plums.
instructions: Rinse the quinoa in a fine mesh strainer and cook according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, mix together the cooked quinoa, black beans, sliced plantains, and diced avocado.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sodium alginate and water to create a spherification bath.
Drop small spoonfuls of the umeboshi plum slices into the spherification bath and let them sit for about 5 minutes to form pearls.
Remove the umeboshi pearls from the bath with a slotted spoon and add them to the quinoa mixture.
Sprinkle the chili flakes and chopped cilantro over the top of the bowl.
Serve the Lazy Sunday Venezuelan Umeboshi Bowl immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Let each person customize their own bowl with their preferred amount of umeboshi pearls and chili flakes.
